nl: 用 antd 风格做行政区管理：查询行政区名称；表格展示行政区名称、人口；下级行政区放在 subAreas 字段里；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Administrative area management with an Ant Design look: query by area name; the table shows area name and population; sub-areas are nested under the subAreas field; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 自定义子节点键名 childrenField=subAreas（antdv/schema）
